Not by default. December 22nd falls inside the year-end code freeze (Dec 15 to Jan 5), while Finance runs the annual close. No production release may go out in that window, hotfixes included, unless a lead in #fin-eng signs off in the channel first.

Your options:

- **Ship before the freeze.** Aim to tag by Dec 14 at the latest. Today is Oct 4, so there's plenty of time. Avoid a Friday after 14:00 UTC, because of the on-call handover.
- **Ask for a freeze exception.** Post the fix in #fin-eng and get a lead's sign-off there. Since Finance is the one asking for the fix, this may be easy to get. Get the approval in the channel before you tag.

If you do release on the 22nd, the usual process applies:

- Complete the PR template's release checklist.
- Tag from main as `v2026.12.N`. CI builds and publishes, so don't publish by hand.
- Staging is promoted automatically. Production needs a manual approval in the CI UI from someone on the billing team.
- Ship any database migrations in the same release as the code that needs them.

Dec 22 is a Tuesday, so the Friday rule isn't an issue. The freeze is the only blocker.
